collectionRules.meet: Observe a creature in its habitat or encounter it through a region event.
collectionRules.bind: Offer a prepared accord token after its Resolve is lowered or its trust condition is met.
collectionRules.refused: A refusal grants a field note and temporarily raises local wariness; it is not a failed capture animation.
collectionRules.release: Release returns the creature to a compatible recorded habitat and may yield a non-exclusive field material.
collectionRules.fatigue: 0–100; high fatigue lowers FOC and blocks risky expeditions until rest.
collectionRules.wildBondedRival: Wild follows habitat rules; bonded follows owner record; rival-bonded cannot be bound.

statuses.effect: -10% DEF for 2 turns; refreshes, does not stack.
Next Spark strike gains +12 power, then clears.

progression.ultraRarePity: No hard pity for power. Use rotating field-research milestones that reveal one eligible habitat clue after repeated valid exploration.
progression.fairness: No paid bind boosts; rarity is authored/seeded and auditably logged.
